jobs.title: Sample Control & Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Alpha Analytical Laboratories**

Alpha Analytical Laboratories, Inc. is a full-service environmental testing laboratory network. We’ve served California since 1975 and run six ELAP-accredited labs across the state. We analyze waters, sediments and solids for drinking water systems, wastewater operations, industrial clients and environmental consultants. We also test for agencies that enforce permits, including the EPA, the State Water Resources Control Board, and county and city agencies.

Our Southern California lab in Signal Hill is growing. We’re looking for an organized, dependable team member to run sample control and support client project coordination.

**Sample Control**

* Receive incoming samples, review chains of custody (COCs), and inspect sample condition
* Log samples into our laboratory information management system (LIMS), assign work orders, print and attach labels, and prepare bench sheets
* Organize and store samples for laboratory processing
* Tell project managers or clients right away about errors, omissions or unclear testing requests on COCs
* Set up new client accounts in LIMS
* Pack and prepare samples for transfer to our other labs by GLS and FedEx
* Be the main point of contact for walk-in clients

**Project Coordination**

* Assemble sampling kits for clients and for field staff and couriers
* Maintain the field staff and courier schedule
* Track and restock bottles and sampling supplies (bottles, pH strips, coolers, etc.)

**What We’re Looking For**

* High school diploma (minimum requirement; BS preferred)
* Experience in data entry, a science background, or lab experience is preferred but not required. We’ll train the right person.
* Extremely strong attention to detail and strong organizational skills
* Clear, professional communication with clients and coworkers
* Very comfortable with computers and Microsoft Outlook; Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) experience preferred
* Able to lift up to 50 lbs

**Benefits**

* PPO health insurance (eligible after 90 days)
* 401(k) with company match (eligible after 12 months)
* Paid time off

**Schedule**

* Monday to Friday
* 8-hour day shift

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $23.00 - $26.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Education:

* High school or equivalent (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Project Access provides programs and services to over 27,000 children, families, and seniors living in affordable housing communities across the country. We strive to empower residents of affordable housing communities through our onsite services, aiming to create pathways for self-reliance and personal growth.  
  
Join the Project Access team and create impact in the lives of our residents. Hear from them and how their lives have changed: www.project-access.org/success-stories/

**The opportunity**

The Resident Services Coordinator designs and implements programs that enhance community life for residents of all ages. They serve as a vital link between residents and services, creating value through targeted initiatives that address community needs. This role requires an innovative, proactive individual who excels in an autonomous environment, driving positive long-term outcomes through an understanding of the communities in which they serve.

**What you'll do**

* Implement core programs and services, which include connecting, engaging, and empowering residents across four initiatives: Economic Stability, Education for Youth & Families, Health & Wellness, and Community Building.
* Conduct outreach and survey resident needs through community engagement aligned with our four pillars.
* Coordinate and oversee an after-school program and teen program encompassing homework assistance and educational enrichment activities.
* Independently plan, prepare, and facilitate resident-facing workshops and group sessions. When external partners are unavailable, deliver core topics directly to maintain consistency and resident engagement.
* Develop & maintain partnerships with local providers to deliver services and workshops.
* Plan & facilitate community-building events that foster safe and meaningful relationships between community members.
* Provide residents with information & referrals to access community resources and services, specifically connecting residents with nonprofit partners who deliver services within our four pillars framework.
* Support food distribution needs in the community, including maintaining food bank partnerships and distribution management.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with the property management team, scheduling regular communication sessions.
* Organize and conduct monthly outreach requirements including door-to-door outreach, digital/virtual outreach, and physical presence in high-traffic locations.
* Recruit, select, train, and oversee volunteers and interns who support programming at the Resource Center.
* Use personal automobile to acquire program supplies and donations and attend offsite meetings (mileage reimbursed at IRS rate).
* Publish monthly newsletters and calendar of events.
* Collect & submit program outcomes data with emphasis on social impact data collection to measure outcomes within our four pillars.
* Provide input and adhere to budgets for resident service programs, including authority to utilize funds for contractors when needed.

**What you'll bring**

* Four years of experience in multi-family housing or related fields such as social services or community outreach; or a Bachelor's Degree in Social Work, Human Services, or related field.
* Minimum of one year experience in both:
* + after-school programs or educational settings for youth
* + serving diverse populations, demonstrating cultural competency and community awareness.
* Proficient with MS Office (Excel, Word, Publisher, Outlook). Basic with Adobe Acrobat, Canva, Salesforce, Concur.
* Strong time management, administrative, and organizational skills.
* Self-starter, multi-tasker, and strong communicator
* The physical activity of this position includes minimal bending, walking, kneeling, reaching, and step climbing. Able to lift up to 30 pounds, which includes large boxes of food for a supplemental food distribution program.

**Credentials/Certifications**

* Valid Driver’s License, clean driving record, and current automobile insurance

**Job Summary**

The Ecommerce Coordinator runs the day-to-day execution behind the L’AGENCE website: product setup, catalog accuracy, inventory visibility, and content readiness across ecommerce channels. The role works closely with the Senior Merchandiser, marketing, CRM, and operations.

**Examples of Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Manage product import and maintenance, including specifications, updates, and imagery coordination.
* Set up and maintain seasonal product catalogs, including attributes, imagery, pricing, and categorization, so each launch is accurate and on time.
* Maintain the master product attribute list across internal and external systems.
* Run daily QA checks on product accuracy, availability, and site presentation, and escalate issues.
* Execute onsite merchandising updates, such as collection and category sequencing, badges, and homepage modules, as directed by the Senior Digital Merchandiser.
* Partner with the Senior Merchandiser and operations on inventory tracking, preorders, markdowns, and campaign readiness.
* Support the website and email content calendar, ensuring timely delivery of assets and product accuracy.
* Organize and prepare content for digital campaigns for seamless execution.
* Provide data entry, reporting, and competitor and site benchmarking support to ecommerce, marketing, and CRM teams.
* Assist in approving product reviews and share insights with internal partners.
* Partner with CRM and Digital Marketing leaders on campaign processes as needed.

*The preceding functions have been provided as examples of the types of work performed by employees assigned to this job classification. Management reserves the right to add, modify, change or rescind the work assignments of different position and to make reasonable accommodations so that qualified employees can perform the essential functions of the job.*

**Skills/Competencies & Qualifications:**

* 1 to 3 years of experience in ecommerce, merchandising, or catalog management, ideally in fashion or apparel.
* High attention to detail and strong organization across multiple deadlines.
* Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, with comfort in product data and basic reporting.
* Familiarity with an ecommerce platform such as Shopify and a product information system.
* Clear written communication and a collaborative approach.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, merchandising, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Physical Requirements:**

* This position is an office position that requires frequent use of a computer, mouse and keyboard.
* Frequent sitting.
* Occasional standing, bending, stooping.
* Must be able to travel domestically and internationally.

*Requirements are representative of minimum levels of knowledge, skills and/or abilities. To perform this job successfully, the employee must possess the abilities or aptitudes to perform each duty proficiently. Continued employment remains on an “at-will” basis.*

jobs.title: Paid Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:

**Job Title**

Paid Media Coordinator

**Department**

Media

**Employment Type**

3 Month Contract to Full-Time Hire

**Location**

Hybrid - Burbank, CA

**Experience**

Entry-level / Experienced Entry-Level `

**Salary**

$28.5hr - $33.65hr ($60K - $70K)

**Role Purpose:**

The Paid Media Coordinator is a core support and execution-focused role within the Media team. The primary function is to assist the daily operational, tactical, and administrative requirements of media campaigns across content creators, endemic media, self-serve, auction-based platforms (primarily Google, and paid social). This position is responsible for ensuring the accurate setup, proper pacing, consistent monitoring, and quality assurance of campaign delivery, providing critical support to Senior Planners and Supervisors. This position is a three month contract with an opportunity to be transitioned to a full time role.

### **Core Functions and Responsibilities:**

The duties of this position are divided into four primary functional areas:

#### **1. Campaign Setup and Stewardship (40%)**

This function ensures the technical accuracy and continuous delivery of all live campaigns, as well as necessary administrative documentation.

* **Setup & QA:** Execute the complete technical setup of campaigns, including the accurate configuration of pixels, UTM tracking, creative uploads, ad creation, and trafficking for both Google, endemic media and paid social platforms.
* **Tracking Management:** Generate, compile, and QA all necessary UTM tracking links required for approved media plans.
* **Pacing & Delivery:** Conduct mandatory weekly (or as needed) checks on campaign pacing and delivery. Identify and proactively flag any under/over-delivery risks or budget discrepancies to the Supervisor/Planner.
* **Operational Coordination:** Liaise with Planners to maintain an updated tracking log of all pending materials (creative assets, ad copy, landing page URLs, client approval) required for campaign launch or maintenance.
* **Financial & Project System Support:** Assist the team with updating and maintaining internal financial tracking and project management systems to ensure accurate record-keeping of budgets, deliverables, and timelines.
* **Billing Support:** Assist the Media Planners/Director with monthly account reconciliation processes for media spend and documentation.
* **Data Contribution:** Gather and organize campaign performance data points to contribute to both internal performance reviews and external client reporting decks.

#### **2. Paid Social Execution Support (30%)**

This function supports the implementation and maintenance of biddable social campaigns.

* **Campaign Execution:** Implement and manage campaign settings and biddable formats across platforms (Meta, X, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit) to align with client goals (e.g., engagement, acquisition, awareness) as directed by the supervising Planner.
* **Audience Research:** Conduct and compile initial research on targeting parameters, audience segments, and competitor activity to support strategic planning phases.
* **Optimization Support:** Under supervision, perform routine campaign optimizations, including minor bid adjustments, budget shifts, and testing of new ad copy/creative within active campaigns.

#### **3. Influencer Execution Support (30%)**

This function supports the implementation and maintenance of influencer campaigns.

* **Identification & Outreach:** Assist in identifying, vetting, and coordinating outreach to relevant influencers and content creators based on audience demographics, brand alignment, and campaign goals.
* **Continued Communications:** Manage day-to-day communication with influencers and creator partners, including deliverable requirements, contracts, content timelines, posting schedules, tracking links, and campaign expectations.
* **Performance Review:** Monitor influencer campaign performance metrics, including reach, impressions, engagement, clicks, and conversions, flagging any significant deviations from campaign goals.

### **4. Media Technology & Growth**

* **MarTech Stack:** Maintain working knowledge of the internal technology stack required for campaign execution, including budget management systems, data visualization tools, and ad verification platforms.
* **Measurement & Tagging:** Support the team by executing and validating third-party tracking implementation, including **Google Campaign Manager 360 (GCM) tagging and reporting** functionality.
* **Professional Development:** Proactively pursue necessary platform certifications (e.g., Google Ads, Meta Blueprint) and attend internal training sessions to ensure skills remain current with rapidly evolving media technologies.
* **Process Improvement:** Participate in internal meetings to share observations on operational efficiencies and contribute to the refinement of campaign setup and QA protocols.

Requirements:

### **Required Skills and Experience**

* **Experience:** Entry-level or 1-2 years of professional experience in communications, digital media execution, operations, or a similar role.
* **Education:** Bachelor's Degree in Advertising or Marketing Communications related field.
* **Platform Proficiency:** Foundational working knowledge of key digital platforms, including Google Ads (Search/YouTube) and self-serve social platforms (Meta, TikTok, X, etc.) is a plus.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Worksheets for data organization and manipulation.
* **Systems Familiarity:** Experience or familiarity with utilizing financial or project management software for data input and tracking is a plus.
* **Core Competencies:**
  + **Detail Orientation:** Demonstrated commitment to accuracy and precision in all setup, tracking, and data entry tasks.
  + **Work Management:** Strong organizational ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks and prioritize requests efficiently.
  + **Communication:** Effect

jobs.title: Studio Operations & Client Relations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us**

At Oxygen Yoga & Fitness, we are a fast-paced, high-energy boutique fitness studio specialized in Far Infrared Hot Yoga and intense fitness classes. We pride ourselves on delivering a personalized, elite experience for our members. We do not just sell memberships; we build a strong fitness community.

**Who We Are Looking For**

We are NOT looking for a passive receptionist who just wants to sit at a desk, check a box, and get free classes. We are looking for a proactive, tech-savvy, and detail-oriented operator to manage our front desk, client relationships, and retention systems.

If you are a critical thinker who loves diving into customer management software, reading client history to solve problems, and building authentic relationships, this role is for you.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Proactive Client Management:** Manage daily outbound and inbound client communications through Mindbody and Axle CRM.
* **Personalized Problem Solving:** Review deep client message history and billing files to fully understand a member's context before responding. (Strictly no mindless, generic copy-pasting).
* **Membership Consultation:** Identify and recommend tailored membership options, class packages, and upsells based on the unique needs of our clients.
* **Studio Operations:** Seamlessly handle check-ins, process client payments accurately, audit account histories, and maintain an organized, spotless studio environment.
* **Class & Perk Accountability:** Represent the brand professionally. Studio perks (including free classes) are a reward for operational excellence, high energy, and reliable performance.

**Key Requirements**

* **Extreme Attention to Detail:** double-check your work, remember client details, and never leave a message request unaddressed.
* **Tech-Savvy & Resourceful:** Experience with or a strong ability to quickly master complex CRM software (Mindbody, Axle CRM, or similar platforms). You know how to use help centers to problem-solve software issues independently.
* **Active Communication Skills:** Excellent verbal and written communication. You write with empathy, accuracy, and clear intent; not just templates.
* **Hospitality or Service Mindset:** Background in high-volume administration is highly preferred.

**This Job is NOT For You If:**

* You are just looking for a quiet place to do homework or look at your phone.
* You struggle to navigate digital dashboards or audit billing histories.
* You handle client inquiries by sending quick, preformatted sales scripts without looking at their past account history.

**How to Apply**

To show us that you actually read this description and possess the attention to detail required for this role, please submit your resume and include the phrase "Infrared Proactive" at the very top of your application message. Applications without this phrase will be automatically disqualified.

Pay: From $20.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* A client messages the studio saying: 'I need to change my membership because my schedule changed, what are my options?' Walk me through the exact steps you would take and the details you are looking for before you type out your reply to them.

Experience:

* Sales administration: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

Born from Impact Networking during a time when that need was rapidly growing, DOT Security was created to deliver a more proactive, personalized approach to cybersecurity.

What makes DOT special is that we've never lost sight of why we started. We exist to help organizations operate with confidence, while investing in talented people who are passionate about solving complex challenges and protecting what matters most. We've built something special, but we're far from finished. The people who join DOT today will help define what comes next.

**Job Overview**

DOT is seeking to fill the role of Channel & Business Development Executive. This role drives new business growth through direct sales prospecting in the upper SMB market and through the development and management of channel partner relationships. You will build and manage a pipeline of opportunities, prepare and deliver quotes and proposals, and work to expand DOT's market reach through both direct engagement and partner-sourced business.

* Demonstrate active listening & critical thinking skills & comprehend received information
* Interpret & understand complex & evolving concepts in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
* Maintain awareness of technology advancements & their cybersecurity implications

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

* Proven experience selling cybersecurity, managed IT, or related technical services
* Collaborative approach to working across internal teams and external partners
* Strong relationship-building skills with both prospects and channel partners
* Sales-focused mindset with experience managing a pipeline from prospecting through close
* Strong organizational skills to manage multiple concurrent deals, quotes, & partner relationships

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Endex builds AI agents that handle complex, end-to-end work for the world's most demanding teams. Today we're deployed across leading financial institutions and Fortune 500 companies, embedded in the tools and workflows they rely on. We operate at the frontier of agentic knowledge work, partnering closely with top AI research labs and backed by the OpenAI Startup Fund. We're on a mission to build the most capable digital coworker in the world.

**About the Role**

**Location:** New York City, San Francisco, Los Angeles, London  
**Commitment:** 5 Days In-Person

We're looking for someone who makes customers successful, not just satisfied. Our customers run agents on real work, where the output has to be right the first time.

As a Customer Success Manager at Endex, you'll own deployment, onboarding, adoption and renewal across our accounts. You'll work directly with our founders, AEs and product team to shape how customers succeed and what we build next.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* **Own Customer Outcomes:** Be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of accounts from signature through renewal. Know their goals, their teams and exactly where Endex fits in their work.
* **Lead Deployments:** Get new customers live fast. Run kickoffs, configure integrations and partner with IT and InfoSec to clear the path to production.
* **Train and Enable Users:** Run onboarding sessions and workshops that show teams what agents can do across email, Teams, Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Make every user productive in their first week.
* **Drive Adoption:** Monitor usage, find the teams getting the most value and replicate it across the firm. Turn a single team's pilot into firmwide deployment.
* **Protect and Expand Accounts:** Spot risk early and fix it before it becomes churn. Surface expansion opportunities and partner with AEs on renewals and upsells.
* **Be the Voice of the Customer:** You'll hear every request, edge case and frustration first. Translate that into product feedback, bug reports and roadmap input that keeps us ahead.
* **Build the Function:** Create the onboarding playbooks, health metrics and support processes we'll scale on. You're not just running customer success. You're helping define it.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Proven customer leader:** 2+ years in customer success, account management, implementation or consulting. You've owned enterprise accounts and grown them.
* **Customer-obsessed:** You care whether the people you work with actually succeed. You follow up, follow through and make yourself the person customers call first.
* **Technically fluent:** You learn new software quickly and can explain it to anyone. You're comfortable working through integrations, security questions and edge cases with engineers.
* **Credible with experts:** You can hold your own with analysts, operators and executives. You learn a domain fast and speak its language.
* **Commercially minded:** You see renewals and expansion as part of the job. You know how to turn a happy customer into a bigger one.
* **Relentlessly resourceful:** You move fast, leverage your network and figure things out without a playbook.

**Nice to Have**

* Early-stage startup experience
* Experience deploying AI, developer tools or enterprise software

**Full-Time Benefits**

* Health & Dental Insurance
* Monthly Wellness Stipend
* 401K Matching
* Competitive Salary + Equity

jobs.description:
**ROOFCORP of America, Inc.**

Sales Coordinator Commercial Roofing | Anaheim, California Full-time, on-site | Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM | No nights, no weekends

**ABOUT ROOFCORP OF AMERICA**

We have been repairing, restoring, and replacing commercial flat roofs since 1985. We specialize in TPO, built-up roofing, and silicone restoration for building owners and property managers across California, Oregon, Washington, and Alaska. We are a family-run company with more than 40 years in business and offices in Anaheim, Seattle, and Bogotá, Colombia. Many of our people have been with us for twenty years or more. We operate on a simple standard: do honest work, do it right, and take care of the customer. Quality here is personal, not a department.

**JOB OVERVIEW**

The Sales Coordinator is the hub of our Pacific Southwest sales operation. Our estimators are out on roofs and our sales team is in front of customers. You are the person who makes sure nothing behind them falls through the cracks: proposals go out on time, bids are submitted before the deadline, follow-ups actually happen, and customer records stay accurate. This is a visible role with real ownership. You will work directly with our Anaheim field team, our Sales Manager in Seattle, and our back office in Bogotá. If you are organized, you like deadlines, and you take pride in catching mistakes before anyone else does, you will do well here.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

- Log incoming leads, service calls, and bid invitations accurately, the same day they arrive. - Build proposals and roof condition reports from estimator field notes and photos, clean, professional, and error-free before they reach a customer.

- Track the bid board: due dates, addenda, plan-room submittals, and prequalification packets. - Schedule roof inspections and estimator appointments, coordinating routes so field time is used well.

- Follow up on open proposals on a set schedule and keep the pipeline current. - Maintain customer and project records: contacts, insurance certificates, W-9s, and vendor portal registrations.

- Produce a weekly pipeline and activity report for the Sales Manager.

**REQUIREMENTS**

- Two or more years in sales coordination, project administration, estimating support, or inside sales support.

- Construction, roofing, or another skilled trade is a strong plus, but we will train the right person. - Excellent written English. Your documents go directly to building owners and property managers.

- The ability to learn new software quickly.

- Genuine attention to detail. In this seat, a wrong address or a missed deadline costs real money.

- Reliable on-site attendance, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

- An associate's degree is preferred but not required. We value hands-on experience equally.

**PREFERRED**

- Bilingual English/Spanish. - Experience with CRM systems or construction bid platforms such as BuildingConnected, iSqFt, Procore, or PlanHub.

- Experience serving commercial property management customers.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

- $28.00 – $34.00 per hour, depending on experience. Candidates with commercial roofing, bid platform, or property management experience start at the upper end of the range.

- Paid sick leave. - Paid holidays.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply through Indeed with your resume. Please include a short note of a few sentences telling us why this role is a good fit for you. In this position, written communication matters, and we read every note. ROOFCORP of America, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act.

Pay: $28.00 - $34.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person

As you establish a strong customer base, the position becomes increasingly relationship-driven, with more of your time focused on managing, retaining, and expanding the accounts you have developed.

Who We're Looking For

We want someone with **B2B inside sales experience** who understands that building a successful book of business takes consistent effort. Medical sales experience is a plus.

The right person is:

* Competitive and highly self-motivated
* Comfortable proactively pursuing new business
* Persistent without being discouraged by rejection
* Naturally good at building business relationships
* An excellent communicator on the phone and through email
* Organized and disciplined with follow-up
* Able to identify opportunities and move quickly
* Motivated by financial success
* Interested in building something over the long term rather than simply collecting a paycheck
* Able to work independently while also contributing to a team

Experience selling pharmaceuticals, medical supplies, healthcare products, or other B2B products is valuable, but **industry experience is not required if you have demonstrated B2B sales ability and are willing to learn.**

Compensation

This position is intentionally **commission-heavy with a smaller base salary.**

We want our salespeople to have meaningful upside when they perform. Your earning potential will be driven largely by your ability to develop accounts, generate profitable sales, and grow your book of business.

**High performers will have the opportunity to earn substantially more than they would in a traditional salary-heavy sales position.**

What Success Looks Like

In the beginning, success means **activity, persistence, and account development.** You should expect to spend significant time prospecting, contacting potential customers, and creating new relationships.

Over time, the goal is to **build a valuable book of repeat customers.**

We want our salespeople developing relationships that produce repeat orders, referrals, larger opportunities, and long-term revenue.

As your customer base grows, your role will increasingly shift from pure prospecting toward **managing and expanding the relationships you've created.**

This Position Is a Great Fit If...

You are the type of salesperson who looks at a commission plan and thinks about the upside rather than the guarantee.

You enjoy competing.

You like developing relationships but aren't afraid to pursue new business.

You want your income to increase as your skills, customer base, and sales increase.

And most importantly, **you want an opportunity where exceptional performance is rewarded.**

If you're talented, hungry, persistent, and ready to build a serious book of business in the pharmaceutical and medical supply industry, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator - Marin
jobs.description:
*Review the full job description* *here**.*

**Youth Leadership Institute (yli)** brings together young people and their adult allies to create positive community change that promotes social justice and racial equity. With community-based programs based in Fresno, San Francisco, Marin, San Mateo, Merced, Long Beach and the Eastern Coachella Valley, yli engages young people of color, low-income youth, and other impacted youth as advocates of social change.

**yli CORE VALUES**

* **Inclusion**: Young people are profoundly impacted by policies affecting their communities. yli brings youth to the table and works to institutionalize youth voice in the decision-making process.
* **Innovation**: Youth can often see a way forward where adults cannot. yli encourages youth to identify and implement their own solutions to the issues their communities face.
* **Social Justice**: Throughout history, young people have ignited and led social justice movements to create a better world for everyone. yli helps them to focus their attention on the root causes of injustice, and sharpen the skills they need to tackle them.
* **Community**: Nobody can do it alone! Through relationship and coalition-building, yli feeds the connective tissue within our communities to power our movements with the brilliance, resourcefulness, and wisdom of our partners.

  

We are looking for a **Program Coordinator (PC)** in **Marin County.** The PC will work in partnership with youth (ages 12 – 24) to organize, empower and mobilize youth and their communities to win real improvements for Marin County young people.

The PC will train and support youth leaders to develop and deepen political consciousness, assess and understand issues impacting their health and well being, build relationships and partnerships with other youth and community supporters, and drive countywide and local community campaigns that create long- term systems and/or policy change, and build power for future victories.

This individual is responsible for managing all of the logistics and functional tasks necessary for meeting the goals and objectives of the assigned programs, and for ensuring that the young people are experiencing high-quality and culturally relevant leadership opportunities.

The PC will implement up to 3 school-based Friday Night Live programs (FNL). FNL is an evidence-based youth development framework to aid in the reduction of youth substance use, as well as implementing our Social Emotional Learning track through FNL. The PC will work directly in partnership with a variety of youth cohorts and adult allies to lead work that supports and leverages local efforts to amplify youth voices and create sustainable social justice change.

**If you’re a good fit for this position, we encourage you to apply. Send us your resume and cover letter on our** **website****.**

We are looking for candidates with:

* Commitment to yli’s values of community, inclusion, innovation, and social justice
* B.A. and/or a minimum 2-3 years relevant experience in field of youth development
* Commitment to social justice, public health, and community organizing as strategies to affect change
* Experience with social media and media relations
* Demonstrated capacity to work with youth and adults from communities of color and low-income communities
* Able to work some evenings and weekends
* Access to a personal vehicle and clean driving record, with the ability to transport youth

  

This position requires in-person work in the Marin County office or in the community 4 days per week, with the option to work remotely on the 5th day.

This is a full-time non-exempt position with a rate of $27.77/hr - $30.54/hr. Compensation includes yli’s generous benefits package:

* Fully-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance (free options available for all staff, and yli pays 50% of dependent premiums)
* Paid time off (~50 days per year with Wellness Leave, Vacation/PTO, holidays, breaks, and your birthday holiday combined)
* $500/year for mental health or lifestyle spending accounts
* Health, commuter, and dependent care flexible spending accounts
* 403(b) retirement plan with 4% match after one year of service

  

**To apply, submit your cover letter and resume on our** **website****.**

**NO RECRUITERS**

***Inclusion sits at the center of yli’s programs.***  
*We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for all members of our staff, clients, volunteers, subcontractors, vendors, and clients. People of color, LGBT persons, and people with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Youth Alumni who have participated and completed programs at yli are strongly encouraged to apply. yli is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against its employees or applicants based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, ancestry, age, medical condition, ability, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, HIV/AIDS status and/or any other protected basis.*

Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We’re hiring a **Global Account Manager, Consulting & Research Agencies** to own and aggressively grow Outset’s relationships with the world’s leading **management consulting and professional services firms**.

A global consulting firm is not one customer; it’s hundreds. Strategy, customer and CX, digital and product, marketing, private equity and due diligence practices each run research for their clients—across dozens of countries, with partner-level budget owners and engagement-by-engagement buying. Firms also increasingly want to deliver AI-powered research as part of their own client offerings. * Build and maintain a live global account plan for each firm: every practice, industry group, region, and research function; partner-level relationships; whitespace and spend; competitive position; and a dated path to each expansion.
* Convert **engagement-by-engagement usage into firm-wide and multi-year agreements**, including enterprise licenses, preferred-vendor status, and global MSAs.

* Direct the extended account team (Sales Development, Research Operations, Account Director, Solutions Consultant, Marketing, and executive sponsors) across functions and time zones.
* Run executive business reviews that tie Outset to firm outcomes—faster engagements, higher-margin delivery, and differentiated client offerings—and convert them into committed budget.
* Negotiate and close complex agreements—global MSAs, multi-region commitments, procurement, security, and client-data confidentiality reviews—in partnership with Legal, Finance, and leadership.

**Qualifications**

* Deep understanding of how consulting firms buy: **partner-led decisions, practice and regional budgets, engagement-funded spend**, and central procurement.

You’re a former independent P&C agent who has quoted, bound, serviced and renewed policies. Now you'll draw on that experience to help build and implement technology that helps agents win more premium.

PolicyLift services a book of over $1B in premium, and we're adding agencies faster every month. This role is the person who helps get new agencies live, keeps their team unstuck, and brings the agent's point of view into what our team builds next. It's a hybrid of three things: product, onboarding, and ongoing agency success.

Customers listen to you because you've done their job. Our engineers listen to you for the same reason. You provide deep industry experience to solve real pain points at independent agencies.

**Why this role exists**
------------------------

PolicyLift does four jobs for independent P&C agencies:

* **Grow.** Website, SEO, AI search and email marketing that bring in leads.
* **Intake.** AI agents, smart forms, and carrier data and documents, so every lead is captured and complete.
* **Submit.** One-click transfer to the systems that matter: AMS, CRM, raters and carriers.
* **Bind.** Comparisons and proposals that get the policy bound.

Every one of those touches the details agents care about: which carrier for which risk, what an HO-5 covers that an HO-3 doesn’t, how a BOP submission differs from a package. Agencies trust us with that work. The person who onboards them, trains their CSRs, and brings their feedback to our roadmap should speak their language fluently.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Insurance Workflow Expertise**

* Work directly with the leadership team on representing the independent agent, informing what we build, in what order, and what "done right" means for an agent.
* Turn real agency scenarios into the standard we build and measure against: the personal lines and commercial lines cases every release has to get right.
* Review new workflows, integrations, and automations before they ship, from the agent's seat.
* Stay up to date on key agency technology such as AMS, raters, intake tools, carrier portals and download feeds our customers depend on, and where PolicyLift fits in each.
* Participate in the industry by visiting agencies in person, attend conferences, and user groups as PolicyLift's most credible voice.

**Onboarding and Implementation**

* Help get new agencies live on PolicyLift.
* Learn how each agency handles intake, quoting, submissions, renewals and servicing, and configure PolicyLift to match.
* Map each agency's stack (AMS, raters, carriers, CSR handoffs) and wire PolicyLift into it.
* Train their team, from a two-person office to a 30-person agency rollout, and hand off a healthy account to our customer success lead.
* Build quick-reference guides, onboarding checklists, role-based training paths and adoption playbooks, and turn one agency's wins into resources every agency gets.

**Support**

* Be the first call when an agency hits something insurance-specific: a quote that doesn't look right, a carrier question, a workflow the AI should handle differently.
* Reproduce, document and triage issues before escalating to engineering, then follow them through to resolution.
* Help drive adoption early (low usage, reverted workflows, a CSR who went back to the old way) and fix the root cause: retraining, a workflow change, or a product request.

**Who you are**
---------------

* **A former (or current) agent.** You hold or recently held a P&C license, and you've spent 3+ years in an independent agency as a producer, or account manager
* **Fluent in personal and commercial lines.** You can explain HO-3 vs. HO-5, when an umbrella makes sense, BOP vs. package, GL class codes, experience mods and commercial auto symbols without looking them up.
* **Hands-on with agency tech.** You've lived inside an AMS, run comparative raters, worked carrier portals and download feeds.
* **A process builder.** You see the whole process from lead to renewal, not just the next task, and you notice where it breaks before you get there.
* **Bilingual: insurance agent and product specialist.** You can earn an agency owner's trust in the morning and walk an engineer through an edge case in the afternoon.
* **Curious about AI.** You don't need to write code. You do need to want to understand how the product works and help it get better.

**Bonus qualifications**
------------------------

* You've owned or run an agency, managed a personal/commercial lines team of producers, or managed a service team.
* Designations such as CIC, CISR, CPCU or AINS.
* You've led an AMS or rater migration or implementation.
* You've tried AI tools in your agency and know where they fall short.
* Any product or tech-adjacent experience.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Fully covered health, dental and vision (full-time only).
* A fast-track to promotion in Product, Customer Success, or Support
* A direct line to leadership: your feedback turns into real product insights
* Meaningful ownership and visibility across company outcomes and internal operations.
* A front-row seat at an early-stage AI company that respects what agents actually do.
* An opportunity to bring your insurance expertise into a leading AI platform for insurance.

jobs.title: Foster Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Foster Program Coordinator**

**Schedule:**

The working schedule for this position is Sunday - Thursday, 9:30AM - 6PM with Friday and Saturday day off.

**Who We Are**

ACC is one of the nation’s largest open-admission animal shelters, whose mission is to End Animal Homelessness in NYC. We touch the lives of nearly 20,000 animals each year. ACC is more than an animal shelter; we are a resource to the community, always seeking ways to keep the human-animal bond intact. With a 90% placement rate, our progressive, life-saving initiatives contribute to the successful placement of our animals.

We strive to find loving homes for homeless and abandoned cats, dogs, guinea pigs and rabbits, both by adopting animals directly to the public and by partnering with more than 200 dedicated animal placement organizations (our New Hope partners). We also help keep NYC communities safe and rescue animals in need, responding to emergencies that involve animals as well as keeping our doors open 24/7 for people and animals in need.

**Summary**

The Foster Program Coordinator is responsible for maintaining the day-to-day operations of the foster program. As a Foster Program Coordinator, you will be responsible for coordinating the movement of animals in and out of foster homes, providing support to a network of over 800 foster parents, and help facilitate the adoption process for every animal in foster care.

**Required Qualifications**:

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* The ideal candidate should have a minimum of two-years work experience in a client facing position.
* Strong computer literacy required.
* Able to excel in a fast-paced, often high-stress, ever-changing environment.
* Treat animals and people with respect and employ humane handling techniques whenever possible.
* Must be able to lift and move up to 50 lbs.

**Benefits**

ACC values work/life balance and offers a generous paid-time-off (PTO) package that includes vacation time, birthdays off, personal days and sick pay. We also value physical and mental health by offering a great open access Cigna medical, dental and vision insurance at a low premium to our employees as well as 401K and Pension, Life Insurance. We also have on-the-job training for 2-4 weeks, periodic all staff trainings to include safety, DEI, cross training, and other growth opportunities.

Because ACC is a nonprofit, employees may be eligible for loan forgiveness, cancellation, and/or consolidation under the Public Service Loan Forgiveness program (PSLF). Created under the College Cost Reduction and Access Act of 2007, PSLF allows borrowers who work full time for nonprofits and government agencies to have their outstanding debt forgiven tax-free on Federal Direct Loans, after making 120 qualifying monthly payments under a qualifying repayment plan.

Please use this link for more details on our benefits package.

**Essential Job Functions**:

* Provide support to foster volunteers to ensure all their needs are being met. This includes answering questions, providing support for behavioral issues, following up with medical concerns, and handling other issues that may arise.
* Coordinate transportation of foster animals to foster volunteers, between care centers, and to adoption events.
* Coordinate with Veterinary Services to ensure foster animals leave the care center with appropriate vaccines and treatment plans, schedule follow-up vet appointments, and assist with handling animals when appropriate.

**Other Responsibilities**:

* Assist in identifying appropriate foster animals for off-site adoption, outreach, and media opportunities.
* Coordinate logistics for foster animals attending events including scheduling behavior assessments, medical, and transport.
* Assist Foster Supervisor with management of foster volunteer database.
* Secure appropriate photographs of animals for foster and events.
* Recruit new foster volunteers through orientations, interviews, and training.
* Lead Open Foster Hours, identify appropriate foster animals to new fosters.
* Fear Free certification within 30 days of hire.
* Complete other duties as assigned by supervisor.

**Preferred Qualifications**:

* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Prior experience with Microsoft Office Suite preferred.
* Prior experience with animals (dogs/cats/rabbits), either paid or volunteer, is strongly preferred but not required.
* Bi-lingual (Spanish) preferred but not required.
* Customer-driven and focused on providing a positive, upbeat, experience for all clients.
* High attention to detail, strong work ethic, and the ability to thrive while working in busy environment.
* Work well independently but also function seamlessly as a member of a team.

**Work Environment:**

At ACC it's all hands-on deck. We work together as a team, which means you may be asked to help with tasks that involve working outside in all sorts of weather. As a busy animal shelter in one of the biggest cities in the world it can get noisy inside. Employees should have the ability to remain calm yet professional in stressful situations involving animals and/or members of the public. ACC houses hundreds of animals in its facilities at any given time and with that comes fur, odors and other airborne particles in abundance.

ACC offers many low-cost services to pets and people in need. This includes compassionate end-of-life services for people who cannot afford to go to a private veterinary office but still want to provide a professional and peaceful transition for their beloved pet.

Training will take place at our Manhattan Centers. Employees will report there until the Bronx location is fully operational.

**Reports To:** Foster Supervisor

**Overtime:** This is a non-union position and is eligible for overtime.

The goal of the position is to facilitate and support a coalition of partners to address the social determinants of health and achieve systems changes that improve birth outcomes.

Under the direction of the Project Director, the Program Coordinator is responsible for coordinating, monitoring, and evaluating consortium activities, community engagement initiatives, and strategic partnerships for the Bronx Healthy Start Program. The position independently assesses program activities, evaluates partnership effectiveness, identifies operational challenges, and develops recommendations to improve program processes and outcomes. The Program Coordinator exercises independent judgment in analyzing information, evaluating alternatives, and recommending appropriate solutions, while implementing program strategies and operational improvements upon approval of the Project Director and in accordance with established program objectives, policies, and grant requirements.

* Independently evaluate consortium activities and partnership effectiveness to identify opportunities for improved collaboration, service coordination, and community engagement.
* Develop and maintain strategic relationships with healthcare organizations, community-based agencies, and other stakeholders to support program objectives.
* Facilitate multi-sector collaborations and assess stakeholder needs to recommend strategies that strengthen program partnerships.
* Evaluate existing referral and partnership processes and recommend improvements to enhance access to maternal, child, and family health services.
* Coordinate the planning and implementation of consortium initiatives consistent with established program goals and strategic priorities.
* Independently assess program activities, stakeholder feedback, and operational challenges to develop recommendations for program improvements.
* Collaborate with consortium members to develop performance measures and evaluate progress toward strategic objectives.

* Represent the program at community meetings and stakeholder events to support collaborative initiatives and partnership development.
* Independently analyze partnership activities, performance indicators, and stakeholder feedback to evaluate program effectiveness.
* Develop recommendations for operational improvements based on program data, participation trends, and survey findings.

* Prepare analytical reports and present findings and recommendations to program leadership to support program planning and decision-making.
* Perform other related duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS:

  + Bachelor's degree in public health, healthcare administration, social sciences, or a related discipline and a minimum of four years of relevant experience; or an equivalent combination of education and related experience, including a minimum of six years of relevant work experience.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Hyphenate**

Most AI companies in finance are building copilots. Hyphenate builds AI agents that do the work.

Hyphenate is the autonomous finance platform for the office of the CFO. Our agents run on top of a company's existing ERP, banks, billing, CRM and contracts, and take on the work itself: order-to-cash and revenue recognition, cash and treasury, procure-to-pay, general ledger and close, and reporting. They learn how each company runs finance, log every action for auditors, and escalate the decisions that need human judgment. No ERP migration, no rip-and-replace.

We are based in New York City and backed by a $9M seed round led by Foundation Capital, with BoldCap, Gaia Ventures, Aravind Srinivas (CEO of Perplexity) and finance leaders from Zuora, Ramp, Gusto, MongoDB, Zoom and the Big Four. Customers include Kiteworks, HiBid, Dura Software, Mini Melts and Rently.

**About the Role**

We are hiring Business Development Representatives to build the outbound engine for the office of the CFO.

The demand is already here. CFOs and Controllers at $100M to $1B companies are being asked by their CEOs how AI will change their teams, and we have the product that answers it. What we need is more conversations. Our BDRs are the people who start them: on the phone, every day, with the finance leaders who run the close, the cash and the revenue at companies in our target verticals.

This is a founding cohort. We are three Account Executives and three BDRs today and plan to be ten of each by the end of January. You will own a vertical, not a list: one segment of the market that you learn cold, prospect end to end, and build the playbook for. You report to our Head of Sales Development, who built the SDR organization at Rippling from three people to thirty, and you will get direct coaching from the CRO and the AEs you book for.

The BDR team is our farm system for Account Executives. We promote from within on discipline, coachability and execution, and we are adding AE seats fast enough that the path is real.

**What You'll Own**

* Own a vertical: run outbound into one segment of $100M to $1B companies (B2B software, CPG, manufacturing, wholesale distribution, construction, hospitality or health services) and become the person on the team who knows it best
* Live on the phone: roughly four hours a day of cold calls to CFOs, Controllers and VPs of Finance, with email and LinkedIn layered in as we stand those channels up
* Book and hold 12 to 15 qualified meetings a month at full ramp, and hand each one to your AE with a real brief: who they are, what hurts, what systems they run, and what happens next
* Work inbound in your segment: content downloads and demo requests route to you, and you follow up the same day
* Research before you dial: ERP, close process, PE backing, hiring signals, so the first thirty seconds of every call land
* Partner with your AE on account plans, multi-threading into the finance org, and reviving closed-lost accounts
* Keep HubSpot clean: every call, meeting and note logged, so the funnel we run the business on is real
* Write and test talk tracks and sequences with the Head of Sales Development; what works becomes the playbook for the next ten BDRs
* Bring the market back inside: the objections you hear, the messaging that lands, and the segments that bite

**What You Should Have Done Before**

* Earned attention from strangers for a living. Either 6 to 24 months as an outbound BDR or SDR with a quota you hit, or a non-traditional background with hard evidence you can do measurable work under pressure: college athletics, a founder stint, client-facing finance or consulting
* Picked up the phone when it was the harder option. Cold calling is the core of this job today, and you should want it to be
* Held a conversation with a finance leader, or shown you can learn enough accounting to hold one within your first month
* Taken coaching well. You want your calls reviewed, and you change what you do when you get the feedback
* Executed a process every day without being chased: the activity, the logging, the follow-up
* Based in New York City or willing to relocate; we work from our Manhattan office five days a week
* High energy, high agency. You bring it to the floor and the people dialing next to you feel it

**You'll Stand Out If**

* You have prospected into finance buyers (CFO, Controller, treasury, RevOps) at a fintech, ERP, billing, close or spend-management company
* You have an accounting, audit or FP&A background, or a CPA you would rather use in a conversation than a spreadsheet
* You were a founding or early BDR somewhere and helped write the playbook, not just run it
* You build your own tooling: AI prospecting workflows, enrichment, call prep, anything that gets you to more of the right conversations
* You competed at a high level in something: Division I sports, a startup you founded, a job with a public scoreboard

**What Great Looks Like Here**

* You treat the phone as the best channel, not the last resort. A live conversation is the strongest pattern interrupt there is, and you go get it
* You want the AE seat, and you are earning it by doing the job in front of you better than anyone else
* You are curious about how a finance team actually closes the books, and you can explain what our agents do for one in two sentences
* You dial with the people next to you, share what is working, and make the floor louder

**The Upside**

* $90K base salary plus $50K in annual on-target commission, for a $140K OTE, and equity
* A real ramp: your first month of commission is guaranteed, month two runs on an adjusted quota, and you are at full ramp by month three
* A real path: the BDR team is where our next Account Executives come from, and we are adding AE seats as fast as we add BDRs
* Coaching every week from a Head of Sales Development who has scaled this exact function, plus call feedback from the CRO and the AEs you book for

**Manufacturer’s Sales Representative / Outside Sales Representative**  
**New York Territory & New Business Development**

**This is an established-territory sales position with a strong new-business development component.**

Stonehenge US is looking for a motivated Outside Sales Representative to manage and grow our established dealer network throughout Brooklyn, Queens, Long Island and surrounding New York markets, while also developing new business and expanding our presence throughout the region.

This is a hybrid sales position combining **account management, territory growth, and new-business development**. The representative will be responsible for maintaining strong relationships with existing dealers, identifying opportunities to grow current accounts, prospecting new dealer locations, and helping expand Stonehenge US into untapped areas of the New York market.

Depending on the candidate’s experience and qualifications, the position may be structured as a dedicated outside-sales role or may include product and sample delivery responsibilities within the territory.

Our products include natural stone veneer, manufactured stone, thin brick, bluestone, limestone and step treads, porcelain pavers, artificial grass, outdoor living products, solar paver lights, iron doors, and other building and hardscape products.

**Compensation & Schedule**

* $70,000 base salary or more if include product and sample delivery responsibilities within the territory.
* Commission of approximately $12,000 for every $1 million in sales
* Monday through Friday
* Approximately 45 hours per week
* Full-time position
* Primarily field-based outside sales

* Company Ford F-150 or other company-provided vehicle depending on the position structure
* Company gas card
* Company E-ZPass
* Company cell phone
* Company iPad
* Product samples, catalogs, promotional materials, and other sales tools
* Company-paid normal business travel expenses

**Territory & Location**

Stonehenge US’s main warehouse and office is located in Staten Island, New York. This position will spend the majority of its time in the field managing and developing accounts throughout Brooklyn, Queens, Long Island, Staten Island, and surrounding New York markets.

Because of the territory, candidates located in or near Staten Island, Brooklyn, Queens, Long Island, or surrounding areas would be well positioned for this role.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Managing and growing an established customer base throughout Brooklyn, Queens, Long Island, and surrounding New York markets
* Researching and identifying new masonry, hardscape, landscape-supply, building-material, lumber, and related dealers
* Scouting and developing new accounts throughout the New York market

**What We’re Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is comfortable both managing an established territory and developing new business.

The right person should be:

* Self-motivated
* Organized
* Persistent
* Comfortable cold calling and walking into new businesses
* Able to research and qualify prospects independently
* Comfortable speaking with owners, purchasers, managers, and other decision-makers
* Able to build and maintain strong long-term customer relationships
* Able to identify opportunities to grow existing accounts
* Able to plan productive routes and manage time efficiently

Experience in building materials, masonry, hardscape, landscape supply, stone, pavers, construction products, contractor sales, or related industries is strongly preferred, although we will consider candidates with strong outside B2B sales experience.

Stonehenge US is a growing supplier and manufacturer of masonry, hardscape, and outdoor-living products serving building-material dealers throughout the Northeast.

* Coordinate execution of contracts, and other documents that need review and signature. This includes reviewing contracts, ensuring signature of ED is obtained, sharing executed contract with fiscal and relevant party.
* Support completion and review of timesheets.
* Ensure ED and CFO approve SCP forms and related HR documents.
* Support the CEO and CFO regarding banking related needs such as providing the CEOs authentication information to banking institutions, financial vendors, funder portals etc
* Support the CEO in the coordination of confidential ICC services for ICC employees such as immigration support

**Meetings**

* Manages logistics for meetings: time, place, refreshments, etc.
* Assist the Executive team in tracking assigned responsibilities and follow up meetings.
* Manages internal administrative meetings and staff/program meetings.
* Support coordination of staff meetings including calendaring of meetings, and supporting items needed for the meetings.
* Support coordination of staff related activities, as requested.
* Assist with external events, as requested by Executive Team Members.

**Development**

* Assembly of proposals, as requested.

* Ensure execution of donor contracts and internal/external distribution;
* File contracts and donor communications in shared drive.

**Board Relations**

* Prepares documents, etc. for Board and Administrative meetings.
* Collects and compiles various reports from departments for distribution and for the Board meetings.
* Coordinates preparation of records such as agendas, notices, minutes and resolutions for Board meetings.
* Scheduling and coordination of board and committee meetings.
* Tracking attendance for meetings.
* Maintains board records.
* Maintains Board contact lists and Board page on ICC website.

**General**

* Works on special projects and other duties as assigned.

**JOB SPECIFICATIONS OR QUALIFICATIONS, SPECIAL WORKING CONDITIONS**

* At least 5 years of Executive Assistant experience supporting senior leadership in an organization.
* Excellent writing and verbal communications skills.
* Must be detail oriented.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality on all matters.
* Ability to work in a past faced environment
* Ability to prioritize and multitask
* Ability to handle frequent changes in daily work schedule/agenda depending on the needs of the CEO
* Must be proficient in Microsoft Office applications and internet surfing/communications applications.
* Requires discretion, judgment, tact, and poise with considerable latitude and flexibility in carrying out assigned tasks.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and credibility at all times.
* Must be a self-starter, able to work independently.
* Ability to prepare and write routine reports and correspondence.
* Must be able to take the initiative and research issues as needed to gain a fuller understanding of matters at hand and provide support as needed.

**Security Technology**

* Coordinate deployment and upgrades of access control, CCTV/video surveillance, intrusion detection, visitor management, and supporting security infrastructure.

* Coordinate installation requirements involving readers, controllers, cameras, network connectivity, power, cabling, and related infrastructure.

* Serve as a day-to-day coordination point for security integrators, contractors, manufacturers, consultants, and service providers.

* Maintain accurate records of project decisions, changes, risks, and outstanding issues.
* Develop routine project status reports and leadership updates.
* Ensure as-built drawings, configuration information, warranties, testing documentation, and turnover materials are collected at project completion.

* Strong organizational, documentation, communication, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to read and work with project schedules, equipment lists, scopes of work, floor plans, and technical documentation.

* Experience supporting multi-site corporate physical security environments.
* Experience working with security systems integrators and installation contractors.

**Job Summary:**

As part of the Student Union, Events and Conference Services department (SUECS), and Production and Technical Services department (PTS), the Production Coordinator reports to the Production Manager and is responsible for coordinating production operations in the Recital Hall and Sasha Gerritson Theatre, as well as providing production support for other PTS-supported events on campus, Board of Trustees meetings and other PTS-supported events at El Centro and CCICS campuses, and NEIU commencements.
  
  
Responsibilities include planning staffing and production services with SUECS staff, student groups, faculty, staff, rental groups, and other clients, providing supervision and direction to student staff, freelance staff, and contractors, executing equipment setups, live sound engineering, lighting design and operation, and providing stage management. After the Operations Unit, the Production Coordinator provides operational support for events in the Student Union as well as other locations around campus.

**Job Description:**

* Coordinates production operations in the Sasha Gerritson Theatre and Recital Hall in support of all concerts, conferences, lectures, third-party and rental events occurring in these spaces.
* Assists the Production Manager with advancing all event needs with NEIU faculty, staff, and external partners, renters, and other event organizers.
* Executes and supervises the following: live sound engineering, including creating patch lists and stage plots; projection system operation; stage management, including calling performance cues and moving stage equipment; lighting design, programming, and operation, including hanging and focusing lighting instruments; rigging and fly system operation; audio and video recording and post-production, and additional production services as needed.
* Supervises and directs a staff of student workers, freelance employees, and contractors to meet the production needs of events in the Sasha Gerritson Theatre and Recital Hall, working within budget constraints.
* Assists the Production Manager with creating training and protocol documentation.
* Suggests improvements to administrative systems in support of departmental responsibilities.
* Enforces University policy, and assists the Production Manager with creating and revising policy for the Production Unit.
* Maintains equipment and records, including troubleshooting, cleaning and repairing audio, video, lighting, and control equipment, verifying and updating inventory documentation, maintaining and updating standard patch list documentation, maintaining and updating lighting repertory (rep) plots, creating and updating technical venue documentation, updating firmware for equipment, and notifying the Production Manager of any issues outside of this scope.

**Overview**

The Marketing Coordinator is a creative, design-focused member of the marketing team responsible for bringing our brand, events, and neighborhood initiatives to life across social, digital, email, and print channels.

Graphic design is at the heart of this role. The Marketing Coordinator will lead the day-to-day execution of creative materials for our core events, programs, and campaigns while helping establish a consistent and compelling visual identity across the organization.

In addition to design, this position will support social media content creation and management, website and email marketing, and other special marketing projects. The ideal candidate is a strong visual storyteller who can move comfortably between creative execution and collaborative project work.

This role works closely with the Marketing Director and regularly collaborates with staff, committees, Board members, businesses, vendors, and community partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Graphic Design & Creative*

A significant portion of this position will be dedicated to graphic design and creative production.

* Lead day-to-day graphic design for organizational marketing campaigns, programs, and events.
* Develop creative concepts and visual systems for major events and initiatives.
* Design assets across a wide range of formats, including social media, email, websites, digital advertising, signage, posters, flyers, event materials, and other print collateral.
* Help establish and maintain a cohesive design ethos across the organization's marketing channels.
* Adapt campaign creative across multiple formats while maintaining consistency and quality.
* Prepare production-ready files for print vendors and other external partners.
* Maintain organized creative files, templates, brand assets, and project archives.
* Bring a strong design point of view while remaining flexible enough to incorporate organizational and stakeholder feedback.

*Social Media & Content Creation*

* Create engaging social media graphics, short-form content, and other visual assets.
* Assist with management of the organization's social media channels and content calendar.
* Capture photo and video content in the neighborhood and at organizational events when needed.

*Digital & Email Marketing*

jobs.description:
**Who we Are?**

Intersection is an experience-driven Out of Home media and technology company that delivers programming, consumer amenities, and advertising to cities. From free internet access to way-finding to real-time information, our products make city life easier and more sustainable. We further enrich cities with experiential programming that inspires and engages people throughout their day. With valuable, diverse audiences in America’s top cities, we provide innovative, data-driven solutions for brands to reach urbanites at scale.

**What is the Role?**

Intersection is seeking an upbeat, energetic, and self-motivated Sales Coordinator to join the Client Success Team and work in one of our Central offices! This is a fast-paced, detail-oriented, and varied role that is perfect for someone who has experience in sales support within the media/advertising world. The ideal candidate will have outstanding interpersonal and customer service skills, have a drive to learn and the ability to perform sales support responsibilities and thrive within a team environment. Above all, this individual will provide full support to their Sales Account Executive(s), improve the sales cycles by aiding to activate new processes to ensure we live by “The Intersection Way” - maintaining a collaborative and consultative effort with our Clients.

**What you will accomplish:**

**Within your first month:**

* You will build strong relationships with your Manager, the Account Executives and Account Manager that they support
* You will onboard/train with one of the Client Success Sales Ambassadors
* You will take a deep dive into learning Intersections media and advertising offerings
* You will be a Mentee to other Sales Coordinators to learn the process and systems used within the sales support organization
* You will be exposed to all departments within Intersection and experience how they are part of the sales cycle

**Within your first three-six months:**

* You will be able to support your Account Executives/Account Managers by generating and processing contracts, proposals, and presentations that enable Intersection to scale rapidly
* You will gain exposure and have daily communication with our Clients/Agencies
* You will manage all inventory requests, inventory holds, market avails, media plans / proposals for your Account Executives/Account Managers book of business
* You will generate targeting maps and visuals for RFP responses
* You will handle invoicing requests / billing inquiries
* You will own the pre-sale lifecycle of a contract: initial market research to contract creation and execution, to artwork / specification requests, track production process
* You will research and document competitive requests
* Develop a reputation for being a solid resource and will develop the foundational knowledge of our business model and the various media products and assets
* You will be a “go-to” person who gets stuff done accurately and on time, whether it’s printing materials, setting up meetings with our clients, or building sales decks from scratch
* You will be communicating over email / by phone with internal resources (charting, ad ops, inventory, & account teams) and our Clients to ensure a smooth & positive customer service experience
* You will be a member of a great team at Intersection!

**You're a great fit for this role because:**

* You have a degree from an Accredited Institution
* You have 1-2+ years relevant work experience in a customer-facing customer success, account management or strategic consulting organization
* You can multi-task a number of different items
* You enjoy collaborating with people to get work done, but know when to take ownership of a task
* You demonstrate a high level of accountability for both your work and the work of your team
* You have strong attention to detail and can spot and fix errors
* You work fast but thoughtfully, and make suggestions for efficiencies along the way
* You have knowledge of Adobe and Microsoft Office Suite and do not mind busy work utilizing these tools for RFPs

Total Cash compensation: $50,000 - $55,000

**Hybrid Work Policy:** Our team operates on a hybrid schedule to balance flexibility with face-to-face collaboration. We require all employees to be in the office every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely the remainder of the week.

*At Intersection we celebrate every voice that makes us unique and every perspective that makes us grow. It’s our shared responsibility to create an equitable environment where every employee contributes to the culture of the company. Our products and offerings impact cities across the world and it’s our goal to represent the diversity and differences that make cities special. We will be relentless in that pursuit, because together we are better. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals without regard to race, religion, creed, color, national origin, nationality, citizenship status, ancestry, age, sex, marital status, domestic partnership status, civil union status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic predisposition or carrier status, military status/service, veteran status, mental or physical disability, and all other legally protected characteristics.*
